name: north-star-metric
tagline_zh: 团队指标各说各话？用北极星+3-5个输入指标定方向，先辨业务游戏类型，再按7条标准验证，避免拍脑袋选错。
tagline_en: Tired of misaligned metrics? Define a North Star plus 3-5 inputs, classify your game (Attention, Transaction.
desc_en: Define a North Star Metric and 3-5 supporting input metrics that form a metrics constellation. Classify the business game (Attention, Transaction, Productivity) and validate against 7 criteria for an effective North Star. Use when choosing a North Star Metric, setting up a metrics framework, learning about the North Star Framework, or deciding what to measure.
why_zh: 它把选指标变成可复用的决策流程，先定游戏类型再验证，比拍脑袋或抄竞品更靠谱。
why_en: Turns metric selection into a repeatable process: classify your game first, then validate—more reliable than gut feel or copying.
